meta.audience: A student choosing between the careers the Unspoken Smiles clinic opens onto.
meta.why: The programme is the orientation; the branch after it is the point. A three-star intake sends the student on to the chairside and radiography work an assistant does; anything less sends them back through the shared first ten minutes before they choose a direction.
meta.hostNotes: The branch reads `stars` off the attempt record, which is the engine's own 0-3 verdict. A host that wants a different split changes minStars on the edges and nothing else.

nodes.title: Dental Careers — Unspoken Smiles
nodes.why: The programme itself: SmartCiti.X opens it at the first station the learner has not yet passed, exactly as its own Start button does.

nodes.title: Patient intake and screening
nodes.why: The shared first ten minutes every dental career starts with: the history read and the vitals taken the same way, whoever is going to be doing it.

nodes.title: Radiography — safety and technique
nodes.why: The assisting credential's own component: a student who took the intake cleanly is ready for the room where the dose is the thing being controlled.

nodes.title: Sterilisation and instrument processing
nodes.why: The career behind every operatory: the instrument cycle, which is where an assistant who is strong on procedure and quiet with patients often lands.

nodes.title: Which chair do you want?
nodes.why: The orientation closes on the student's own answer rather than on a score: the check-in asks where they want to go next, and nothing about it is graded.
